notes.title: Delve into the Unknown: Other Side of Mist and Mountain is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Other Side of Mist and Mountain, a Japanese-styled mystery-solving AVG developed by Universe Studio and published by 2P Games, has been released on Steam NOW！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2672060/_/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/50fe8a23d30235ed758866076dab7f7ddd9c943a.png
This game is based on a true urban tale, which makes this game become a suspenseful and sinister detective story with Japanese background. 

Find your beloved missing girl 
In 2005, a sophomore student named Maha Igarashi boarded a private train to Soukyo City. However, she vanished upon alighting at the "Kisaragi" station. Five years later, her lover Shizuno Yokoyama investigated her disappearance, unraveling a series of mysteries along the way. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/98958100bd168311743df79441168bdc7b2f8fa1.png

Delve into the unknown 
You will play the role of Shizuno Yokoyama and open a detective agency specialized on unnatural cases, investigating the occurrence of weird events. You need to go to where strange events happened to investigate every detail of the place. Talk to everyone you meet, find out the clues and information from the smallest details and eventually dig out the truth behind the events. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/cc6ec6bee2cf6e8bfd4ff847283b37c0120ec57a.png

Collect clues and solve mechanism puzzles 
There are a variety of different mechanism puzzles waiting for the player to solve.  Every detail in the scene may be a hint to useful information such as the date on the notebook or the unusual color arrangement of a planet and so on. The game challenges the player's insight and logical reasoning ability through the interlocking puzzle design. In the process of solving the puzzles, you may also fight with something that shouldn’t have existed. Only the sharpest reaction will bring you back alive. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/ef9697b0b6f25accc73992c7bbb05f1925669c82.png

Make choices, change the destiny of everyone 
The game has multiple endings. Every choice will affect Shizuno’s fate and only the correct choice can guide you step by step close to the truth of the incident, while the wrong choice will completely rewrite the fate of everyone. After solving unnatural incidents one after another, you will gradually uncover the truth of the disappearance of Maha Igarashi, and eventually bring the story to its climax. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762300/80defba63f917968f232248952c22df20b382097.png
